title: Factory Droid Slash Command Format
description: JSON Schema for Factory Droid Slash Commands - markdown files stored in .factory/commands/

description.description: Overrides the generated summary shown in slash suggestions

allowed-tools.description: Reserved for future use. Safe to omit.

content.description: Command instructions and workflow as markdown

frontmatter.description: Review code for a specific branch

examples.content:
# Code Review Command

Review the code changes in the specified branch.

## Instructions

1. Compare branch with main
2. Check for code quality issues
3. Suggest improvements

examples.content: Run tests for the specified file and report results.
